3764-4871-8095.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

3652-4053-6989-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

585-3310-7855.notablePrerequisites: You are able to put a counter on War Elemental.
585-3310-7855.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing War Elemental to become a Goblin until end of turn.
Put a counter on War Elemental.
The Great Goblin's first ability triggers, as War Elemental is a Goblin due to Unnatural Selection, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
War Elemental triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1594-4399-4770-6823.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Aunt May trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-4399-4770-6823.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

924-4149-4599-4871-5295.easyPrerequisites: Gravespawn Sovereign is untapped or you control another untapped Zombie.
924-4149-4599-4871-5295.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional creatures.
924-4149-4599-4871-5295.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat steps 1 through 3 two additional times.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ghoulcaller Gisa by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Ghoul.
When Phyrexian Ghoul dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ghoulcaller Gisa ability, creating eight 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Phyrexian Ghoul from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul by sacrificing Ghoulcaller Gisa.
When Ghoulcaller Gisa dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phyrexian Ghoul ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Gravespawn Sovereign by tapping five Zombies, returning Ghoulcaller Gisa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
924-4149-4599-4871-5295.notes: If Phyrexian Ghoul starts with a power of 4 or greater, you can reduce the number of additional creatures you control. It must get to 8 or higher power before sacrificing it to Gisa.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2292-4871-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2292-4871-5220-5243.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7158.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Arcbound Slasher.
When Arcbound Slasher dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Slasher's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Slasher from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

3025-5170-5231-6132.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3490-4050-6097-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4050-6097-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

454-509-1267-5547.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
454-509-1267-5547.description:
Cause Medomai to become an artifact.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris and Thrummingbird.
Idris and Thrummingbird trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Thrummingbird trigger, putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 5.

779-4970-5751-6556.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding Dakmor Salvage.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

813-2104-4598.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Essence Flux.
813-2104-4598.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

397-3641-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-3641-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

465-719-1753-3742-4251.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-719-1753-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

372-2417-4823.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Timeless Witness exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
372-2417-4823.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Timeless Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Timeless Witness trigger.
Resolve the Timeless Witness trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Timeless Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

11-5257-6069.description:
Cast Alchemist's Gambit for its cleave cost by paying {4}{U}{U}{R}.
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Alchemist's Gambit.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Alchemist's Gambit, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Alchemist's Gambit and returning the original Alchemist's Gambit to your hand.
Resolve Alchemist's Gambit, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
11-5257-6069.notes: You may pay an additional {U}{R} to copy the extra turn spell, and only need to do this loop during your second extra turn.

2452-3249-4476-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

914-1170-2493-3130-4074.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
914-1170-2493-3130-4074.description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Resolve the copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Resolve the original Blue Sun's Twilight from step 1, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
The Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, returning Blue Sun's Twilight from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}{U}.
Activate Chandra's third loyalty ability by removing four loyalty counters from it, dealing four damage to up to two targets.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target Archaeomancer and any other creature to get infinite copies of any creature on the battlefield.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

224-322-1993-2167.notablePrerequisites:
Budoka Gardener does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic Forest.
You control less than ten lands.
224-322-1993-2167.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a basic Forest, adding {G}.
Activate Groundskeeper by paying {1}{G}, causing you to put the basic Forest from your graveyard into your hand.
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting the basic Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
The Forest enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Repeat.

2816-3099-3990.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Incubation Druid.
Incubation Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2816-3099-3990.description:
Activate Incubation Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color a land you control could produce.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Incubation Druid by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite {G}, you may activate Leyline of Abundance's ability to put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
